title: Black Friday email sent at 23:30 with English price format (synthetic)
impact: about 118,750 of 312,500 synthetic recipients (38%) received a late-night email showing €1,299.00 instead of 1.299,00 €; 41 complaints
summary: A Greek Black Friday delivery was scheduled in UTC instead of local time and used an English price template. The operator forgot to check the send time.

timeline.what: First customer complaint reaches the market team
Remaining sends paused; 38% of the audience already reached

contributing_factors: Scheduler field shows UTC with no local-time preview
Price block copied from an English template; no locale check before send
Human error under Black Friday volume

actions.action: Add local-time preview next to the scheduler field
Add price-locale and quiet-hours checks to pre-send QA
